usdRate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Australia, AUD/USD 0.7040 (Tuvalu uses the Australian dollar)

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Tuvalu Central Statistics Division, Consumer Price Index Q3 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Annual inflation (Q3 2025 to Q3 2026) 2.4%; 12-month average inflation 3.4%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Tuvalu CPI average annual inflation (Q3): 4.3% 2021, 11.1% 2022, 9.5% 2023, 1.9% 2024, 1.0% 2025, 3.4% 2026; Australian dollar user
inflation_projection.note: Tuvalu uses the Australian dollar (RBA target 2-3%) but import, food and fuel shocks push its CPI higher, so we plan with 3.5%, below the shock-inflated 5-year average.

policy_rate.note: Tuvalu has no central bank and uses the Australian dollar; the Reserve Bank of Australia cash rate applies indirectly.

savings_account_rate.note: Tuvalu's only commercial bank publishes no rate sheet online (its old website is now a parked domain); no official rate table found.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published 3-month term deposit rate found for Tuvalu.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published 1-year term deposit rate found for Tuvalu.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product rate found for Tuvalu.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: World Bank WDI has no FR.INR.DPST value for Tuvalu and there is no central bank publishing one.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail bond for individuals found; the 2026-27 budget shows debt only from external lenders.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No domestic treasury bills found in the 2026-27 national budget.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No domestic government bonds found in the 2026-27 national budget.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No domestic government bonds found in the 2026-27 national budget.

tax_bank_interest.note: The Revenue and Customs Department page gives no rule on interest income; no withholding rate was confirmed.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists in Tuvalu.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit insurance scheme was found for Tuvalu.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No credit card rate or legal cap was found for Tuvalu.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No local stock exchange; global equity index in Australian dollars; No published Tuvalu deposit rates; World Bank average deposit rates in nearby small Pacific markets 0.3-1.6% (Vanuatu 2025, Solomon Islands 2023, Samoa 2025)
equity_return_low.note: Low case for a global index fund in Australian dollars after a weak decade for world shares.

equity_return_base.sourceName: No local stock exchange; global equity index in Australian dollars; No published Tuvalu deposit rates; World Bank average deposit rates in nearby small Pacific markets 0.3-1.6% (Vanuatu 2025, Solomon Islands 2023, Samoa 2025)
equity_return_base.note: There is no local stock market, so the base is a global index in Australian dollars, held to the assumed 1% safe rate plus under 4 points.

equity_return_high.sourceName: No local stock exchange; global equity index in Australian dollars; No published Tuvalu deposit rates; World Bank average deposit rates in nearby small Pacific markets 0.3-1.6% (Vanuatu 2025, Solomon Islands 2023, Samoa 2025)
equity_return_high.note: High case near long-run world equity returns in Australian dollars.

gold_return_low.note: Low case for gold in Australian dollars with a firm Australian dollar.

gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4% plus slight Australian dollar depreciation over time.

gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and a weaker Australian dollar.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: No published Tuvalu deposit rates; World Bank average deposit rates in nearby small Pacific markets 0.3-1.6% (Vanuatu 2025, Solomon Islands 2023, Samoa 2025)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: ordinary savings deposits at well under 1%.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: No published Tuvalu deposit rates; World Bank average deposit rates in nearby small Pacific markets 0.3-1.6% (Vanuatu 2025, Solomon Islands 2023, Samoa 2025)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: term deposits around 1%, in line with deposit rates in other small Pacific markets; no Tuvalu rate is published.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: No published Tuvalu deposit rates; World Bank average deposit rates in nearby small Pacific markets 0.3-1.6% (Vanuatu 2025, Solomon Islands 2023, Samoa 2025)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case if local term deposit rates follow Australian rates up.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No life insurance claim statistics for Tuvalu were found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No term life insurance market with published rates was found in Tuvalu.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No typical out-of-pocket hospital bill was found; public care and the overseas medical referral scheme are government funded.

health_premium_table.note: No private health insurance premium table for Tuvalu was found.

oop_health_share.note: Out-of-pocket spending is 0.045% of current health expenditure (2023); the government funds health care, including AUD 11.4 million for overseas medical referrals in 2026-27.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Tuvalu CPI Q3 2026 report (no separate medical index figure)
goal_inflation_health.note: No medical CPI figure is published, so we plan with the 3.5% headline projection plus one point.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Tuvalu CPI Q3 2026 report (education prices rose within the Miscellaneous group)
goal_inflation_education.note: No education CPI figure is published, so we plan with the 3.5% headline projection plus half a point.

life_table_remaining.note: No life table for Tuvalu was readable: populationpyramid.net does not cover Tuvalu and the WHO GHO API returned errors; the statistics office publishes none.

support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio of 11.74 (2025). No readable source gave UN WPP projections for 2040 or 2065.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Tuvalu National Provident Fund, Retirement Benefit
retirement_age_default.note: Normal retirement age 55 for TNPF withdrawals; voluntary retirement from 50.

retirement_age_government.note: No official page stating the public service retirement age was readable.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: No published Tuvalu deposit rates; World Bank average deposit rates in nearby small Pacific markets 0.3-1.6% (Vanuatu 2025, Solomon Islands 2023, Samoa 2025)

retirement_return_base.sourceName: No published Tuvalu deposit rates; World Bank average deposit rates in nearby small Pacific markets 0.3-1.6% (Vanuatu 2025, Solomon Islands 2023, Samoa 2025)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case at about 1%, in line with deposit rates in other small Pacific markets; no Tuvalu rate is published, so this cannot be checked against a local after-tax rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: No published Tuvalu deposit rates; World Bank average deposit rates in nearby small Pacific markets 0.3-1.6% (Vanuatu 2025, Solomon Islands 2023, Samoa 2025)
retirement_return_high.note: High case if local deposit rates rise with Australian rates.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Mix of local deposits (about 1%) and global equity in Australian dollars; No published Tuvalu deposit rates; World Bank average deposit rates in nearby small Pacific markets 0.3-1.6% (Vanuatu 2025, Solomon Islands 2023, Samoa 2025)
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix mostly in local deposits.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of local deposits (about 1%) and global equity in Australian dollars; No published Tuvalu deposit rates; World Bank average deposit rates in nearby small Pacific markets 0.3-1.6% (Vanuatu 2025, Solomon Islands 2023, Samoa 2025)
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: half local deposits at about 1% and half global equity at 4.5%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Mix of local deposits (about 1%) and global equity in Australian dollars; No published Tuvalu deposit rates; World Bank average deposit rates in nearby small Pacific markets 0.3-1.6% (Vanuatu 2025, Solomon Islands 2023, Samoa 2025)
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case with a larger, well-performing global equity share.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: The 2026-27 budget allocates AUD 2.4 million to the welfare scheme for the elderly and people with disabilities, but no official monthly amount per person was found.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Eligibility age for Tuvalu's elderly welfare scheme was not stated in the budget documents or other official pages we could read.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory gratuity or end-of-service payment for private employees was found; retirement savings run through TNPF.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Tuvalu National Provident Fund, Retirement Benefit
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory provident fund for all working employees; balance available at 55 (voluntary from 50), with a term annuity option. Contribution rates were not stated on the fund's pages.
